stories.title: Mara Sadé Reportedly Signs with All Elite Wrestling
stories.tldr: Former WWE and TNA wrestler Mara Sade has officially signed a full-time, salaried contract with All Elite Wrestling. The move was accidentally spoiled when her newly launched official website briefly included AEW in her biographical details before the mention was edited out. Sade had conversations with WWE and received an increased retention offer from TNA, but ultimately chose to sign with AEW.

stories.title: New Jon Moxley Documentary Trailer Released and Event News
stories.tldr: A new 80-minute documentary titled I Fought Jon Moxley has been announced, chronicling the current AEW Continental Champion's brutal, ultraviolent rise through Combat Zone Wrestling and the independent circuit before his time in WWE. Produced by veteran promoter Steve Karel and CZW owner David Markland, the film is scheduled to premiere on October 13 in select theaters and across major cable and digital platforms. Alongside the documentary release, Karel is stepping back into the promoter circle for live televised events, while Moxley balances his promotional schedule with an upcoming AEW World Championship match against Will Ospreay at All Out and an indie appearance for Defy Wrestling.

stories.title: Kota Ibushi Provides Post-Surgery Recovery Update
stories.tldr: AEW star Kota Ibushi has provided a recovery update after undergoing a second surgery on the femur he broke in October 2025. In a recent video update, Ibushi humorously faked out fans by initially claiming an in-ring return was almost impossible, before passionately vowing to eventually wrestle again. The 44-year-old acknowledged that his leg is in bad shape and will require permanent reinforcement plates, meaning his comeback could take years. Meanwhile, he also continues efforts to support Japanese wrestling venues outside of the ring.

stories.title: Paramount Settlement Clears Path for WBD Merger and AEW Impact
stories.tldr: Paramount Skydance has reportedly reached a crucial settlement with state attorneys general, removing major legal hurdles for its massive merger with Warner Bros Discovery. The agreement includes concessions like independent editorial boards for CBS and CNN, as well as theatrical release commitments and the avoidance of steep daily penalties. This corporate mega-merger carries significant implications for All Elite Wrestling, whose media rights and streaming home on HBO Max intersect with the companies involved. AEW President Tony Khan has previously expressed optimism about the deal and leadership under David Ellison.

stories.title: Mike Bailey Discusses Signing with AEW and Origin of His Nickname
stories.tldr: Speedball Mike Bailey has discussed his transition to All Elite Wrestling in 2025 following his departure from TNA Wrestling, highlighting the strong support and faith shown in him by Tony Khan. Bailey shared how receiving direct feedback and high-profile opportunities, such as a twenty-minute match with Jon Moxley on Collision, demonstrates Khan's trust in his abilities. He also reflected on overcoming a near-career-ending five-year US work visa ban by building momentum internationally in Japan, Europe, and Mexico before finally signing with a major American promotion. Additionally, Bailey revealed the origins of his famous ring name, explaining that a Montreal wrestling writer named Michael Ryan coined the moniker early in his career because he bounced around the ring like a speedball.

stories.title: Tommaso Ciampa and Motor City Machine Guns Set for House of Glory Show
stories.tldr: AEW stars Tommaso Ciampa and the Motor City Machine Guns have been announced for upcoming independent events with House of Glory. Ciampa will make his promotional debut at the Salvation event on October 9 at the Amazura Concert Hall in Jamaica, New York. Meanwhile, Alex Shelley and Chris Sabin are scheduled for action at the Windy City Warfare event in Chicago on September 25, which will stream live for free on YouTube. Opponents for both Ciampa and the Motor City Machine Guns have not yet been named by the promotion.

stories.title: Britt Baker Backstage Update Following AEW Return
stories.tldr: Britt Baker recently made her long-awaited return to the All Elite Wrestling ring on the September 9 episode of Dynamite titled Rebel Heart. She teamed up with Hikaru Shida and Persephone to secure a victory in a six-woman tag team match. Following this emotional comeback, backstage updates indicate that the former AEW Women's World Champion is officially back on the road and scheduled for multiple upcoming television dates. Fans are now speculating about her next moves, particularly with an upcoming show taking place in her hometown of Pittsburgh.

stories.title: Former AEW Champion Expresses Frustration Over Lack of TV Time
stories.tldr: Former AEW Women's World Champion Nyla Rose recently opened up about her prolonged absence from television, admitting that the lack of booking is frustrating. Despite staying active on the independent circuit and holding championships elsewhere, she has not appeared on AEW programming since late last year. During a recent interview, Rose expressed her desire to be featured more prominently and entertain fans on a larger scale.

stories.title: AEW All Out 2026 PPV Surprises and Predictions
stories.tldr: As AEW prepares for All Out 2026 at the NOW Arena in Chicago following All In London, anticipation is high for major landscape-shifting moments. Potential surprises include Samoa Joe returning to confront Jack Perry, Dani Luna debuting to help Thekla defeat Willow Nightingale, and tension within The Death Riders boiling over against Jon Moxley. Additionally, former WWE stars Ilja Dragunov and Kairi Sane are heavily rumored to make their promotional debuts in front of the live Chicago crowd.

stories.title: Jim Ross Provides Health Update
stories.tldr: AEW commentator Jim Ross recently provided an update on his ongoing health struggles during a podcast appearance. After being urged by his daughter, Ross underwent biopsies for several concerning moles on his back. He is also continuing to deal with a lingering ankle wound that stems from previous skin cancer treatments. Despite these continuous medical hurdles, Ross remains determined to get as close to full health as possible.

stories.title: Myron Reed Responds to Online Criticism After AEW Collision Match
stories.tldr: During the September 19, 2026 episode of AEW Collision, Darby Allin successfully defended his TNT Championship against Myron Reed. A dangerous spot where Reed crashed through a chair during a dive sparked heavy online criticism from industry veterans regarding wrestler safety. Reed defended his training and safety precautions, while his Rascalz partner Zachary Wentz also strongly came to his defense.

stories.title: Steven Borden Jr. Debut in AEW
stories.tldr: Following Sting's retirement, both of his sons are pursuing professional wrestling careers after receiving training from Darby Allin and Dustin Rhodes. Garrett Borden recently made his AEW debut in a dark match prior to Collision in Charleston, West Virginia, where he defeated Kiran Grey. This development hints at a potential future where the brothers tag together on television, especially as Steven Borden Jr. prepares for a major tag team match at All Out this weekend.

stories.title: Sammy Guevara Teases AEW Return Status
stories.tldr: Sammy Guevara has been absent from regular AEW and Ring of Honor programming, with his appearances remaining sporadic since June. Although AEW President Tony Khan addressed speculation regarding his standing with the company back in July, fans continue to wonder about his future. Guevara has now added to the discussion by sharing a gym photo on social media. In his post, the former TNT Champion indicated that he is doing everything he can while waiting for his next opportunity.

stories.title: John Silver Celebrates Marriage Over the Weekend
stories.tldr: AEW and ROH star John Silver recently married his longtime girlfriend, Denise Liguori, during a weekend wedding ceremony shared on social media. Fellow wrestler Chuck Taylor attended the celebration, marking the next chapter for the couple following their engagement in June of last year. Professionally, Silver continues to appear on Ring of Honor programming as part of the Dark Order.

stories.title: Truth Magnum Discusses The Outrunners' AEW Contract Journey
stories.tldr: Truth Magnum of the Outrunners believes that AEW President Tony Khan assumed the tag team was already under contract due to how frequently they worked for the promotion before officially signing. Starting as extras, Magnum and Turbo Floyd traveled extensively and followed the touring schedule to secure bookings while receiving vocal backing from veterans like Mark Henry and Chris Jericho. The team eventually solidified their place in the company and captured the ROH six-man titles alongside Dalton Castle, an arduous journey that ensures Magnum never takes a single day of his wrestling career for granted.

stories.title: Solo Sikoa Abducted on WWE Raw, Replaced by Penta in MITB Qualifier
stories.tldr: On the September 21, 2026 episode of Monday Night Raw, Solo Sikoa was abducted backstage by the 946 faction before his scheduled Money in the Bank qualifying match. Adam Pearce named Penta as Sikoa's emergency replacement in the triple threat bout against Dragon Lee and Dominik Mysterio. Penta capitalized on the opportunity by pinning Mysterio with a springboard Mexican Destroyer to punch his ticket to the ladder match in New Orleans. Meanwhile, the 946 group later dropped off an abducted Sikoa at an undisclosed location with a bag over his head.

stories.title: WWE RAW 9/21/2026 Review, Results, and Match Qualifiers
stories.tldr: The September 21, 2026 episode of WWE Raw from San Antonio featured high-stakes Money in the Bank qualifying matches, with Roxanne Perez and Penta securing their spots in next month's ladder matches. Before the men's qualifier, Solo Sikoa was dramatically kidnapped backstage by the 946, leading General Manager Adam Pearce to insert Penta as a replacement where he defeated Dragon Lee and Dominik Mysterio. Meanwhile, Perez advanced in the women's division by pinning IYO SKY in a hard-fought triple threat match that also featured La Catalina.

stories.title: Nic Nemeth Addresses TNA's Absence from WWE Dusty Rhodes Tag Classic
stories.tldr: TNA World and Tag Team Champion Nic Nemeth recently addressed TNA's notable absence from the 2026 WWE NXT Dusty Rhodes Tag Team Classic. While industry reports suggest WWE's partnership with TNA has cooled off as focus shifts toward their newly acquired AAA talent, Nemeth admitted mixed feelings about the exclusion. Although personally too busy with his heavy championship workload to participate, he hopes to see the fruitful crossover relationship reignited in the future.

stories.title: Zoey Serrano (Stark) Opens Up About WWE Release and Backstage Stories
stories.tldr: Former WWE star Zoey Serrano recently opened up on her YouTube channel about her unexpected WWE release, revealing that the sudden news left her feeling like she was experiencing a severe panic attack. She also reflected on bizarre fan backlash regarding a comedic NXT sushi vignette with IYO SKY and shared how WWE coach Terry Taylor saved her career by forcing her to see medical staff after she tried to hide a torn ACL. Serrano, who returned to TNA Wrestling in August, noted that despite the initial heartbreak, she is now using the opportunity to find herself and her confidence again.

stories.title: Lola Vice Officially Signs with WWE RAW
stories.tldr: Former NXT Women's Champion Lola Vice has officially signed with the Monday Night Raw roster following her recent transition from NXT. During her official contract signing hosted by General Manager Adam Pearce on the September 21, 2026 episode in San Antonio, Texas, Vice was immediately interrupted by Roxanne Perez. The confrontation quickly turned physical as the two Money in the Bank ladder match competitors traded insults and shoves before being separated. Vice enters the red brand carrying her strong combat sports background and a clear goal to capture championship gold.

stories.title: WWE Talent Concerned Over Saudi Arabia Security Ahead of Crown Jewel
stories.tldr: Growing backstage concern has emerged among WWE talent regarding the upcoming Crown Jewel event in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, amid escalating regional conflicts and a U.S. State Department Level 3 travel advisory. Recent drone and missile attacks targeting Riyadh and critical infrastructure have heightened fears, though WWE has not yet announced any changes to the November 7 event. Wrestling legends like JBL and Eric Bischoff have weighed in on the situation, with JBL expressing confidence in WWE's safety protocols and Bischoff suspecting the company has a backup plan for future events like WrestleMania 43.

stories.title: WWE Files New SmackDown Trademark for Championship Belts
stories.tldr: WWE recently filed a new trademark with the USPTO for the SmackDown name specifically covering championship trophy belts. The filing lists goods and services for trophies made primarily of common metal for use as awards, namely championship trophy belts. While SmackDown currently hosts several titles like the Undisputed WWE Championship, United States titles, and Tag Team Championship, none currently carry the SmackDown name. This trademark filing could point toward future merchandise, a brand-new championship concept, or simply standard intellectual property protection for the company.

stories.title: Pro Wrestling Rumor Roundup & News Updates
stories.tldr: Recent wrestling updates highlight a cooling relationship between WWE and TNA, alongside notable contract and backstage developments for stars like Damian Priest and Britt Baker. Meanwhile, the industry mourns the passings of former CMLL booker Franco Colombo and veteran manager Bruce Swayze. Additionally, major corporate shifts are underway following a settlement in merger talks involving Paramount and Warner Bros Discovery.

stories.title: WWE Worlds Collide 2026 Broadcast Plans, Ticket Sales, and Start Times
stories.tldr: WWE and Lucha Libre AAA Worldwide are gearing up for Worlds Collide this Saturday at the Allstate Arena in Rosemont, Illinois, though official broadcast confirmation is still pending. Recent reports suggest the event will stream live on YouTube at 8:00 p.m. Eastern, positioning it just an hour after AEW All Out begins. Meanwhile, ticket sales have reached 11,162 distributed tickets, and a loaded match card featuring top talent and championship bouts is locked in for the big night.

stories.title: Former WWE Star Sanga Arrested in India
stories.tldr: Former WWE star Saurav Gurjar, known as Sanga, was arrested at Mumbai Airport and placed in 14 days of judicial custody following allegations of sexual exploitation filed by a 29-year-old woman in India. The complaint, registered under Section 69 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, claims Sanga engaged in a relationship under the false promise of marriage while knowing he was already married. The accuser also stated that the relationship resulted in severe emotional distress and financial loss, including leaving her job in the United States to join him in India. Authorities issued a Look Out Circular leading to his detention upon arriving from the Middle East, and the investigation remains ongoing.

stories.title: CM Punk's Post-Title Loss Future and Money in the Bank Status
stories.tldr: Despite recently losing the Undisputed WWE Championship, CM Punk is expected to maintain a major role on the upcoming Money in the Bank premium live event card. To secure his spot in the ladder match, Punk must first get through a high-stakes triple threat qualifying match against Gunther and Finn Balor on SmackDown. This ongoing rivalry-heavy landscape also keeps Punk intertwined with Sami Zayn and Kevin Owens, offering multiple pathways back to the world title picture.

stories.title: Oba Femi Returns to WWE RAW and Receives Push Update
stories.tldr: Oba Femi has made a stunning return to Monday Night Raw, exacting revenge on The Vision after being sidelined with a scripted rib injury. During his comeback, Femi cleared the ring of Bronson Reed, Bron Breakker, and Austin Theory using a steel chair alongside Je'Von Evans. Alongside his explosive return, WWE has officially updated its roster page to move Femi from his previous free agent status to the permanent Raw roster. This major push follows a breakout 2026 for the powerhouse, which includes defeating Brock Lesnar at WrestleMania 42, winning the King of the Ring tournament, and positioning himself for a future world title clash against Roman Reigns.

stories.title: AJ Styles' The Phenomenally Retro Podcast Comes to an End
stories.tldr: AJ Styles has officially ended his podcast just seven months after its initial launch following his retirement from professional wrestling earlier this year. Co-host Tony Giles announced the cancellation on social media, confirming that the channel is being repurposed into a new gaming-focused show while past episodes remain accessible. Neither host cited a specific reason for ending the project, though Giles assured fans that he and Styles remain good friends. Styles continues to stay busy in retirement through his work as a WWE talent scout and supporting his son's wrestling career.

stories.title: Jim Johnston Criticizes Modern WWE Entrance Theme Songs
stories.tldr: Legendary former WWE composer Jim Johnston recently appeared on Ropes N Riffs to criticize the company's modern approach to entrance music and character development. He argued that letting wrestlers choose their own themes based on personal preference fails to serve their characters, comparing the process to scoring a film where objective distance is required. Johnston also slammed current Def Rebel tracks as interchangeable noise that lacks a true connection to the performers, noting that poor music and disjointed storylines hinder modern star-making.

stories.title: Bully Ray and Jim Ross Discuss Sami Zayn's Title Reign and Matches
stories.tldr: Wrestling veterans Bully Ray and Jim Ross recently offered differing critiques regarding Sami Zayn following his recent Undisputed WWE Championship matches and title reign. Bully Ray analyzed a confusing botch during Zayn's SmackDown defense against Kevin Owens, noting that the referee clearly counted to three before aborting the finish. Meanwhile, Jim Ross addressed Zayn's main event status on his podcast, questioning whether WWE has booked him strongly enough to consistently headline WrestleMania as the company's central attraction.

stories.title: Chelsea Green Reveals Mother Confronted WWE Producer Michael Hayes
stories.tldr: WWE star Chelsea Green revealed on her husband Matt Cardona's podcast that her mother recently confronted veteran WWE producer Michael Hayes backstage. According to Green, her mother walked up to Hayes, introduced herself as Chelsea's mom, and bluntly told him, "F**k you." Hayes then shared the hilarious and awkward interaction with everyone in the producers' office, leading executive Bruce Prichard to question Green about the incident.

stories.title: Neil Patrick Harris Discusses Childhood Love for WWE
stories.tldr: Actor Neil Patrick Harris recently discussed his childhood fandom of professional wrestling during an interview. He admitted to secretly enjoying WWE when he was younger, noting that his attraction to the spectacle served as an early indicator of his sexuality. Harris pointed to the tight shorts, oiled bodies, and grappling as aspects that appealed to him despite feeling like he was not supposed to be watching it that way.

stories.title: JBL Recalls WWE SmackDown Following 9/11 Events
stories.tldr: Reflecting on the 25th anniversary of the September 11 terrorist attacks, WWE Hall of Famer JBL recently recalled the somber and historic episode of SmackDown held in Houston, Texas, just two days after the tragedy. Despite initial cancellations and safety concerns, Vince McMahon gave the roster a choice to perform in order to show American resilience during a turbulent time. The emotional night featured powerful promos, a memorable rendition of the national anthem by Lilian Garcia, and ultimately led to the WWE roster visiting Ground Zero to support first responders.

stories.title: La Catalina Returns to WWE RAW Action
stories.tldr: AAA Reina de Reinas Champion La Catalina recently made her surprising return to WWE RAW in a Triple Threat Money in the Bank qualifying match against Iyo Sky and Roxanne Perez. This marked her first in-ring appearance on the red brand in six years, following her initial 2019 run under the name Carolina and subsequent release as Katrina Cortez in 2021. Competing as part of the ongoing talent sharing relationship between WWE and AAA, Catalina put up a strong fight before Perez ultimately secured the victory to punch her ticket to the ladder match.

stories.title: Liv Morgan Reacts to Loss in Chile as 'Santiago Screwjob'
stories.tldr: Liv Morgan has dubbed her recent WWE Women’s World Championship loss to Stephanie Vaquer in Chile as the Santiago Screwjob, blaming guest referee Becky Lynch for conspiring against her. During a passionate promo on Monday Night Raw, Morgan vowed to reclaim her title, leading to a fiery confrontation with Lynch and a verbal sparring match. Vaquer subsequently addressed the controversy by offering rematches to both women, hinting at a high-stakes triple-threat championship match at the upcoming Money in the Bank premium live event.

stories.title: Roman Reigns and Cody Rhodes Recreate Street Fighter Moves
stories.tldr: WWE stars Roman Reigns and Cody Rhodes are bringing their star power to the upcoming live-action Street Fighter movie in a newly released gameplay comparison trailer. The footage highlights Reigns portraying the demon warrior Akuma and Rhodes starring as the iconic military fighter Guile alongside other classic game moves. The star-studded film is scheduled to hit theaters everywhere on October 16, following an IMAX early screening event on October 15. This crossover adds a major WWE connection to the big screen adaptation as both wrestlers step into the World Warriors arena.

stories.title: Ludwig Kaiser and El Grande Americano Character Discussion
stories.tldr: Ludwig Kaiser has achieved massive success and cultural resonance in Mexico over the past year by playing the masked character El Grande Americano under the WWE-acquired AAA banner. Alongside stablemates Rayo and Bravo, Kaiser has become a phenomenon, currently holding the AAA Mega Championship after defeating Dominik Mysterio. While there is no current reason to alter this winning formula, his eventual unmasking could lead to major main event storylines on mainline WWE television. Creative angles involving a rivalry with GUNTHER or a calculated heel turn could eventually bring Ludwig Kaiser back to his unmasked persona.

stories.title: Dragon Lee's WWE Contract Situation and Future Update
stories.tldr: Dragon Lee is approaching the expiration of his WWE contract, and officials reportedly want to re-sign the high-flying star due to his rising profile and recent high-profile television bookings. Beyond regular programming, his lucha libre background could make him a valuable asset within the company's growing AAA landscape. His future ultimately hinges on whether WWE's upcoming contract offer meets his financial expectations. Meanwhile, reports note that he and his brother Dralistico are nearing the ends of their deals and have trademarked the name Hermanos Lee.

stories.title: Reflecting on Forgettable WWE World Championship Reigns
stories.tldr: Following Sami Zayn surpassing the length of his first title reign, wrestling history is filled with surprisingly brief championship runs. Some of the most forgettable reigns include Batista holding the belt for just one day in 2009 due to injury and Mr. McMahon surprisingly winning the title for four days in 1999. Additionally, Randy Orton and Triple H famously traded the championship twice in a single night at No Mercy 2007, resulting in reigns lasting less than a day.

stories.title: Discussion on New Stars and Title Contenders on WWE RAW
stories.tldr: WWE Raw has welcomed several new stars throughout 2026 who are poised to capture their first main roster championships. Analysts have highlighted three standout talents including Je’Von Evans, Lola Vice, and Oba Femi as prime candidates for upcoming gold. With major career momentum and recent high profile achievements, these rising names could soon redefine the championship landscape on the brand.

stories.title: WWE Faces Backlash Over Trick Williams Shirt Design
stories.tldr: WWE recently faced significant online backlash after releasing a new t-shirt for NXT star Trick Williams featuring his Lemon Pepper Steppers catchphrase. The front of the shirt displays his signature white boot surrounded by fried chicken wings, intended as a literal visual pun. However, fans quickly pointed out the painful racial stereotypes associated with fried chicken and Black individuals, questioning how the design ever passed corporate approval. The controversy highlights a major tone-deaf misstep by the company regarding merchandise for one of its top Black stars.

stories.title: CM Punk vs Grayson Waller Proposed for WWE Wrestlepalooza in Perth
stories.tldr: WWE is returning to Perth, Australia for Wrestlepalooza at the RAC Arena on Saturday, December 12. With Rhea Ripley currently sidelined, NXT Champion Grayson Waller stands as a prime candidate to headline his home country event. WWE has already teased a potential feud by posting backstage confrontation footage between Waller and CM Punk from an NXT live event. Pitting Punk against Waller would provide an electric main event atmosphere for the international card.

stories.title: Mr. T Recalls Initial Pushback to His WrestleMania Role
stories.tldr: Mr. T recently reflected on the professional and personal challenges he faced while transitioning into professional wrestling for the inaugural WrestleMania. Speaking on a podcast, he explained that while some performers resented his presence and failed to grasp the business strategy, Hulk Hogan helped guide him through the process. Their bond, which began on the set of Rocky III and grew during The A-Team, ultimately helped bridge the gap between wrestling and mainstream pop culture.

stories.title: Natalya Defends NXT Heatwave Finish and Training Jaida Parker
stories.tldr: Natalya recently defended the finish of her match against Jaida Parker at NXT Heatwave, explaining that the outcome successfully carried out Shawn Michaels creative vision for their storyline. She noted that professional wrestling functions like a theatrical play where performers execute the booker's overarching direction. Furthermore, Natalya revealed that she and TJ Wilson had been privately training Parker in areas like submissions, conditioning, and vocal delivery before their on-screen feud even began. Ultimately, she views helping rising talent succeed as a personal victory that elevates the entire division.

stories.title: Speculation on New Allies for LA Knight & Solo Sikoa Against The Bloodline
stories.tldr: LA Knight and Solo Sikoa are currently targeted by both The Bloodline and 946, sparking speculation about who will step up as their third partner for a potential WarGames match at Survivor Series 2026. Penta remains a strong candidate after his recent near-miss against Roman Reigns, while Seth Rollins has already previewed the role during recent live event appearances. Additionally, the long-absent Drew McIntyre has been floated as an intriguing wild card option to round out a powerful babyface trio.

stories.title: Maria Kanellis Shares Frustrations Over Past WWE Gimmick
stories.tldr: Maria Kanellis recently reflected on her time in WWE playing a deliberately ditzy backstage interviewer, admitting the gimmick initially made her angry and felt like she was being put in her place. Rising from the 2004 Diva Search and an off-the-wall promo in OVW overseen by Paul Heyman and Vince McMahon, Kanellis felt the character reinforced restrictive stereotypes she had fought against since childhood. Although she spent years hating the role and feeling it held her down, she eventually came to see that it carved out a unique lane for her and ultimately pushed her career higher.

stories.title: AJ Lee Recalls Unplanned Promo That Earned WWE Opportunity
stories.tldr: AJ Lee recently shared how an unexpected moment at a WWE tryout helped shape her iconic wrestling persona. After saving for two years to attend the paid tryout, she was put on the spot to deliver a promo on the first day without any preparation. Instinctively pivoting into a villainous character that contrasted sharply with her sweet appearance, her edgy performance convinced officials to give her a chance. That improvised moment ultimately birthed the defining traits of the character she portrayed throughout her career.

stories.title: Where Is Enzo Amore Following Big Cass' WWE Return?
stories.tldr: Big Cass recently returned to the WWE roster, but his former tag team partner Enzo Amore is noticeably absent despite initial plans for a tandem reunion. While Cass has returned as a veteran heel working with younger talent like JeVon Evans, his singles run has largely failed to capture fan excitement. Enzo was recently spotted at the WWE Performance Center and backstage at NXT, leading to speculation about whether a return is still being planned. Although past controversies surrounded Enzo, his absence and silence suggest that a future reunion with Cass could still happen under the current management regime.

stories.title: Tiger Ali Singh Details Alleged Jim Ross Sabotage in WWE
stories.tldr: Tiger Ali Singh recently discussed his late 1990s WWE signing, revealing that Vince McMahon offered him a blank check and a long-term deal to help secure international television rights. According to Singh, Bret Hart played a pivotal role in connecting him with McMahon, while his father secured a role as the company's first international ambassador. However, Singh alleges that his career was intentionally derailed behind the scenes. He specifically blames Jim Ross for sabotaging his run by failing to book him on house shows and misrepresenting his willingness to work to his peers.

stories.title: Eric Bischoff Proposes WWE Territory System Revival
stories.tldr: Former WCW President Eric Bischoff recently proposed that WWE should revive a modern version of the classic wrestling territory system across various international markets. Speaking on his podcast, Bischoff pointed to WWE's business strategy and the success of the AAA brand as a blueprint for utilizing existing promotions globally. He suggested establishing localized, franchise-style brands in regions like Japan, the UK, Ireland, India, and Germany. This approach would allow WWE to foster regional rivalries and connect with fans through grassroots local touring.

stories.title: Tyson Dupont Reflects on Surprise WWE Release After Surgery
stories.tldr: Former WWE superstar Tyson Dupont recently discussed his surprising release by the company that came just weeks after he underwent hip surgery. Although he was caught off guard by the timing of the April 24 cut, Dupont admitted he largely expected the departure due to being off television for ten months. He expressed gratitude that WWE fully covered his medical expenses for the surgery even after letting him go. Ultimately, Dupont views the transition with a positive mindset, seeing it as an opportunity to get healthy and make room for others to pursue their wrestling dreams.

stories.title: Wade Barrett Praises Commentary Partners Michael Cole and Joe Tessitore
stories.tldr: WWE SmackDown color commentator Wade Barrett recently expressed high praise for his broadcast partners, Michael Cole and Joe Tessitore, during an interview with Fightful. Barrett labeled Cole as the greatest of all time in professional wrestling commentary, highlighting their automatic chemistry and his experience learning from him. He also commended Tessitore for rapidly adapting to the wrestling industry and bringing infectious enthusiasm to Friday nights, noting Tessitore's successful multi-talented work under the TKO umbrella with Zuffa Boxing.

stories.title: Eric Bischoff Compares WCW Blood Rules to WWE Netflix Edits
stories.tldr: Wrestling veteran Eric Bischoff recently drew on his past experience running WCW to discuss potential corporate restrictions on blood regarding WWE programming on streaming platforms. Speaking on his podcast with Conrad Thompson, Bischoff recalled strict Turner mandates prohibiting blood entirely, even on pay-per-view broadcasts, which required post-production edits. The hosts also theorized that differing rules between live broadcasts and replays could potentially encourage fans to watch events live as a deliberate business strategy, though they noted this was purely speculation without inside information.

stories.title: Rob Conway Recalls Vince McMahon's Feedback on La Resistance
stories.tldr: Former WWE star Rob Conway recently recalled a memorable conversation where Vince McMahon praised his in-ring ability by ranking him just one tier below Bret Hart. However, McMahon also advised Conway and his tag team partner Sylvain Grenier to prioritize their anti-American gimmick over having great matches by focusing on waving their flags and antagonizing the crowd. Conway explained that this feedback helped them understand their roles as villains during their La Resistance run. Reflecting on his later singles career, Conway noted that while McMahon valued his work, he was never actually promised an Intercontinental Championship reign despite hoping for that push.

stories.title: Dustin Rhodes Credits Savio Vega for Goldust Character Success
stories.tldr: Dustin Rhodes recently revealed that Savio Vega played a crucial role in helping him successfully develop the provocative Goldust persona during a pivotal Madison Square Garden match. Rhodes struggled initially with the character's boundary-pushing behavior until Vega encouraged him to lean into it, resulting in a massively hostile crowd and an enthusiastic reaction from Vince McMahon. Additionally, Rhodes shared that his famous WrestleMania appearance was originally planned differently, involving a scrapped street fight against Razor Ramon instead of the iconic Hollywood Backlot Brawl.

stories.title: Mason Rook Recalls Meeting John Cena Before Arriving in WWE
stories.tldr: Mason Rook recently shared the surprising story of his first meeting with John Cena while doing extra work in Glasgow, where the veteran revealed he already watched Rook's UK independent matches on television while filming abroad. Cena has continued to publicly praise Rook since his official WWE debut earlier this year, much to the newcomer's gratitude. During the same interview, Rook also addressed online fan criticism regarding his physical appearance. He discussed whether he might consider losing weight in the future, balancing the uniqueness that brought him to the company with the possibility of a physical transition.

stories.title: WON Flashback: WWE Unforgiven 2003 Review
stories.tldr: This WON flashback looks back at the bizarre tag team match between broadcast colleagues from WWE Unforgiven 2003 on September 21. Dave Meltzer awarded the bout just one star, criticizing the lack of prior advertisement for the unique no-announcing stipulation. The match featured Al Snow and Jonathan Coachman defeating WWE announcers Jerry Lawler and Jim Ross after outside interference from Chris Jericho.

stories.title: Dominik Mysterio Teases New Judgment Day Member
stories.tldr: Omos recently addressed the possibility of aligning with Dominik Mysterio and joining The Judgment Day following his feud and win over Rey Mysterio at AAA Triplemania 34. Speaking during a recent interview, the giant stated that his services are available for the right price and that he is ready to help Dominik conquer the world. This potential alliance stems from Dominik assisting Omos in a bout against the AAA General Manager. Wrestling analysts have since begun questioning whether an official recruitment offer is on the horizon.

stories.title: Bayley Returns to WWE Ring but Gets a Surprisingly Cold Reaction From Live Crowd
stories.tldr: Bayley made her first televised in-ring return since July on the September 21 episode of RAW, facing off against Lyra Valkyria in a continuation of their heated feud. Despite the high stakes and history between the two competitors, the San Antonio live crowd delivered a surprisingly cold and split reaction to Bayley. Valkyria ultimately capitalized on the chaotic bout to secure a pinfall victory over the former women champion.

stories.title: John Cena Clears Up His Relationship With The Rock Following Infamous WWE Heel Turn
stories.tldr: John Cena recently clarified his current relationship with The Rock following his shocking heel turn at WWE Elimination Chamber 2025, where he aligned with The Rock and betrayed Cody Rhodes. During a recent Fan Expo appearance, Cena denied rumors that he sold his soul to The Rock in exchange for the alliance. Instead, Cena explained that his motivation was purely about winning a championship rather than making any supernatural deals. He also confirmed that he believes The Rock never acquired Cody Rhodes' soul either, despite their previous tense encounters on the road to the event.

stories.title: Gurv Sihra (Sunil Singh) Recovering After Collapsed Lung During Match
stories.tldr: Former WWE star Gurv Sihra, known as Sunil Singh of The Bollywood Boyz, suffered a collapsed lung during an independent match in Lethbridge, Alberta. Despite the terrifying injury occurring from a routine move, Sihra managed to finish the bout before collapsing backstage and requiring emergency medical attention. He later shared on social media that an ER doctor told him he was lucky to be alive, and he is now recovering with support from his family, fans, and promotion.

stories.title: Wrestlers Defend Matt Riddle Following Viral Parking Lot Match
stories.tldr: Former WWE star Matt Riddle recently wrestled in an unconventional parking lot match for Appalachian Championship Wrestling against Josh Bishop, with footage quickly going viral on social media. While some online critics mocked the unique setting as a career downfall compared to his days in major promotions, fellow professional wrestlers quickly rushed to his defense. Matt Cardona and Karl Anderson both pushed back against the negativity, emphasizing that working in smaller, independent venues is simply a normal part of the wrestling business.

stories.title: Zac Amico and Mac Davis Discuss JCW and GCW Crossover
stories.tldr: Zac Amico recently addressed his limited appearances for Jersey Championship Wrestling, explaining that juggling a full-time stand-up comedy career in Brooklyn and the associated travel constraints make frequent bookings difficult. Meanwhile, Amico praised the promotion's ongoing crossover with Game Changer Wrestling for allowing talent to cross over and be seen by new audiences. However, tension exists behind the scenes as Mac Davis pushed back against claims from GCW that they are solely responsible for bringing new viewers to JCW, arguing that the relationship is mutually beneficial and that visiting talent also get a rub from the established JCW fan base.

stories.title: Jonathan Gresham Launches Brooke Havok Recovery Fund and New Promotion
stories.tldr: Former ROH World Champion Jonathan Gresham has launched a recovery fund for wrestler Brooke Havok to help with medical expenses and bills during her career-pausing injury, noting she was one of the peers who helped him return to the ring following his 2025 stroke. In addition to supporting Havok, Gresham has announced the launch of a new professional wrestling promotion named ROUND 1, utilizing a Modern Age Grappling style. Set to debut on January 9, 2027, the new venture is being created in collaboration with QT Marshalls 1 Fall Wrestling and PRODUCE. This major career step follows Gresham recent appearances for PRODUCE, including winning the Pez Whatley Invitational co-promoted with ASE and ACTION Wrestling.

stories.title: Top Matches and Title Changes in Wrestling History for September 21
stories.tldr: September 21 holds a rich history in professional wrestling, featuring numerous legendary matches and hundreds of major title changes. Historic bouts include a five-star classic between Hiroshi Tanahashi and Katsuyori Shibata, alongside fierce encounters across promotions like New Japan, Ring of Honor, and AEW. Numerous championships have changed hands on this date over the decades, ranging from historic regional titles to prominent world championships in WWE, WCW, and beyond.

stories.title: NJPW Announces 'Bound For Unbound' Event
stories.tldr: New Japan Pro-Wrestling has added a brand-new event to its 2026 calendar titled Bound for Unbound, which will take place on November 20 at Korakuen Hall in Tokyo. The special show is being uniquely presented by the promotion's Unbound Co. faction, featuring a star-studded lineup of members including IWGP Heavyweight Champion Yota Tsuji, Shingo Takagi, Jeff Cobb, and Gedo. Fan club ticket sales for the event are scheduled to begin on September 25, while additional matches, wrestlers, and specific event details will be announced by the promotion as they are finalized.

stories.title: Miku Kanae Sidelined with ACL Surgery
stories.tldr: T-Hearts wrestler Miku Kanae has been sidelined for the foreseeable future after suffering a torn ACL. The three-year veteran is scheduled to undergo surgery on October 7th and has addressed her fans through extensive social media posts regarding her recovery. Kanae, who began her career in 2022, has competed for numerous promotions across Japan before her last match on September 10th.

stories.title: Ryan Nemeth Discusses Initially Turning Down TNA
stories.tldr: Ryan Nemeth recently revealed that he initially turned down multiple offers to join TNA Wrestling because he was badly burned by negative behind-the-scenes experiences in the industry. He had reached a point in his personal life where he wanted nothing to do with professional wrestling due to its brutal nature. However, persistent outreach from a TNA representative who pitched a specific creative storyline involving him and his brother, Nic Nemeth, eventually changed his mind. After deciding to take a calculated risk, the mutual trial period proved successful, leading to his current run with the company following his departure from AEW and ROH.

stories.title: Masha Slamovich Signs with MLW
stories.tldr: Masha Slamovich has officially signed with Major League Wrestling after debuting at the Fightland tapings and defeating Shotzi Blackheart for the MLW Women's World Featherweight Championship. Reports indicate she signed in early July with creative plans to align with CONTRA and feud with Blackheart. This marks a major career step following her return to wrestling in January 2026 after stepping away in late 2025 due to domestic abuse allegations by her former partner AKIRA. Additionally, the promotion is expanding its reach with the Fusion show heading to Tubi.

stories.title: Ash by Elegance Opens Up About Health Issues During TNA Absence
stories.tldr: Ash by Elegance has been absent from TNA Wrestling for several months due to ongoing physical health struggles that began nearly a year ago. Although television storylines framed her time away as a mental health break, she clarified that she is simply prioritizing her wellbeing for the first time in her career. After rushing her initial recovery and experiencing setbacks in the ring, she remains sidelined but is eager and open to a future in-ring return.

stories.title: Gringo Loco and Partner Welcome Newborn Child
stories.tldr: Independent wrestling star Gringo Loco and his partner Amber Nicole have welcomed their first child, a baby girl named Aria Nicole Santo, into the world. Born on September 21, 2026, the healthy newborn weighed 6 pounds and 14 ounces and measured 19 inches long. The couple, who have been together for eight years, received an outpouring of congratulatory messages from across the professional wrestling community.

stories.title: Steph De Lander Defends OnlyFans Involvement in Wrestling
stories.tldr: Steph De Lander is defending the integration of OnlyFans into the professional wrestling industry, arguing that sexuality has always been present in the sport. She emphasizes that the major shift today is that female performers are now directly profiting from their own content and work. While acknowledging the challenges of balancing content creation with a busy wrestling schedule and travel, De Lander confirms that wrestling remains her ultimate dream and primary ambition.

stories.title: Sam Stackhouse & KJ Orso Discuss Tag-Team Main Events
stories.tldr: Independent wrestlers Sam Stackhouse and KJ Orso recently advocated for tag-team matches to receive more main-event opportunities based on overall match quality rather than traditional booking biases. During a joint interview, they highlighted successful high-profile examples like the Usos facing Sami Zayn and Kevin Owens at WrestleMania to prove tag teams belong in the spotlight. The duo also discussed their recent championship success and expressed deep admiration for the Hardy Boyz, revealing aspirations involving both Matt and Jeff Hardy.

stories.title: Leyton Buzzard Sidelined After Surgery Following Title Defense
stories.tldr: RevPro Undisputed British Cruiserweight Champion Leyton Buzzard revealed he wrestled almost an entire match with a completely torn ACL during his title defense against Nino Bryant. Following successful ACL replacement surgery, the under-30 star admitted he is unsure if he will ever wrestle again due to suffering his second major knee injury. He is currently focusing on his recovery and contemplating whether walking away from the ring is his best option for his long-term health.

stories.title: Moose Defends TNA Wrestling Amid Talent Departures
stories.tldr: TNA Wrestling star Moose recently addressed fan frustration surrounding talent departures from the promotion. During a media appearance, he explained that roster turnover is a natural and recurring part of the professional wrestling business. Moose noted that performers leave for various reasons such as better pay, new opponents, or fresh environments, which ultimately creates opportunities for rising talent. He also urged fans not to automatically blame TNA when his own eventual departure from the company eventually takes place.

stories.title: Gable Steveson's Future Following Recent Combat Sports Events
stories.tldr: Former Olympic gold medalist Gable Steveson suffered a stunning 12-second knockout loss to Sean Sharaf at a recent UFC event, continuing his struggles in professional combat sports. This setback follows an underwhelming and sporadic run with WWE after signing a high-profile developmental contract in 2021. Despite his elite amateur wrestling credentials, Steveson has struggled to adapt his skills to either professional wrestling or mixed martial arts. As a result, his future in combat sports and sports entertainment is facing serious questions.

stories.title: CMLL Legend and Booker Franco Colombo Passes Away at 73
stories.tldr: Former CMLL luchador, booker, and trainer Franco Colombo, whose real name was Javier Esparza Coronado, has passed away at the age of 73. Trained by Diablo Velasco, Coronado spent decades with the company as both a competitor holding the Mexican Welterweight title and a backstage official who revamped the developmental system. His niece announced his death on social media, while the promotion has not yet publicly addressed his passing. Despite his monumental contributions to training and booking, his final departure from the company in 2021 was clouded by reported backstage friction and pandemic-related disputes.

stories.title: Bryan Alvarez Book Signing and Philadelphia Match Announced
stories.tldr: Wrestling journalist and figure Bryan Alvarez is heading to Philadelphia this Sunday, September 27, for a busy day featuring a book signing, a Q and A session, and an in-ring match. He will sign copies of his new book, Pro Wrestling for Dummies, and host a fan Q and A at the First Unitarian Church for ten dollars starting at one p.m. Later that evening at five-thirty p.m. for a separate ticket price, Alvarez will wrestle Dr. Ethan Wilde at the Labor of Love We Real Cool independent wrestling show. The event card also features appearances by wrestlers such as Cheeseburger, Leon Ruff, Matt Mako, Marcus Mathers, JTG, and KJ Orso.

stories.title: DragonKingKarl Historic Wrestling Retrospective
stories.tldr: Wrestling historian and author Karl Stern recently dedicated an episode of his show to exploring the retirement of William Muldoon, widely considered the most famous professional wrestler in the United States during the 1800s. By examining insights from a new biography by Scott Beekman, Stern was able to uncover additional details that complement his own Pioneer Era Pro Wrestling Omnibus. This new information allows wrestling enthusiasts to better understand the circumstances surrounding the retirement of the legendary figure known as The Solid Man. Furthermore, the analysis sheds light on Muldoon's subsequent post-wrestling endeavors, which ultimately propelled him to an even greater level of fame.

stories.title: MLW Signs New Television Streaming Deal with Tubi
stories.tldr: Major League Wrestling has officially launched its flagship program Fusion on Tubi, with new episodes airing every Thursday night on the free streaming platform. The agreement, finalized in August, includes a rights fee and a revenue share for library content, though the exact duration of the partnership remains undisclosed. This development arrives nearly five years after MLW filed an antitrust lawsuit against WWE over allegations that WWE pressured Tubi to drop MLW, a legal battle that was ultimately settled in December 2023. MLW owner Court Bauer praised Tubi for sharing the promotion's fan-first philosophy of keeping content free from paywalls and subscription barriers.

stories.title: Kevin Nash Nixed Scott Hall Hologram Concept
stories.tldr: Kevin Nash revealed on his Kliq This podcast that he vetoed a proposal by WWE to create a posthumous hologram of his late best friend Scott Hall for a Hall of Fame tribute around WrestleMania 38. Nash explained that because the passing was too fresh and he believed Hall would never have approved such a gimmick for him, he acted as the deciding vote to shut it down. Furthermore, Nash expressed a broader ethical opposition to AI avatars and holograms of deceased individuals, arguing that exploitation by surviving parties is wrong and that the dead should be left alone without proper prior consent via a will.

stories.title: Mickie James Suffers Eye Injury on Farm
stories.tldr: Women's wrestling legend Mickie James was forced to miss her scheduled appearance at the Hamilton Comic Con over the weekend. She suffered a minor eye injury while working on her farm on Friday, leaving her barely able to open the affected eye. Although she attempted to travel, the airport environment, bright lights, and necessary event preparations made the pain unbearable. James ultimately decided to return home rather than appear before fans in misery, promising that she will make it up to them in the future.

stories.title: Ganon Jones Jr. Retires Following Final Match with Andy Williams
stories.tldr: Independent wrestler Ganon Jones Jr. has announced his retirement from the ring following the tragic death of Andy The Butcher Williams. Williams passed away at age 48 after suffering a medical emergency during their match at an Enjoy Wrestling event on September 5. Jones made the difficult decision to step away primarily because the traumatic incident deeply frightened his young daughter, who was in attendance. While Jones leaves the door open for a potential return in the future, he is currently prioritizing his role as a father.

stories.title: STARDOM Fukuyama Results: Konami Wins, Hina Defeats Miyu Amasaki
stories.tldr: STARDOM continued its Silver Week Tour with an event in Fukuyama at Big Rose, highlighted by key victories for the H.A.T.E. stable. Hometown fighter Konami led her team to a main event win by pinning Saya Iida after using black spray and a punt kick. Earlier on the card, Hina scored a major non-title upset by pinning Goddess of Stardom Champion Miyu Amasaki with the Mad Splash. The show also featured ongoing championship previews, including another look at the upcoming Wonder of Stardom title match between Hanan and Ruaka.

stories.title: Danshoku Dieno Captures DDT Ironman Title in Niigata
stories.tldr: Danshoku Dieno surprised Ilusion with a Lip Lock and pinfall to capture the Ironman Heavymetalweight Championship following DDT Pro-Wrestling's September 19 show in Niigata. The opportunistic ambush occurred after Ilusion interrupted a closing announcement to boast about his championship status, which came on the heels of an earlier tag team victory on the card. Meanwhile, the main event featured HARASHIMA defeating Super Sasadango Machine in a bout celebrating Sasadango's 24th anniversary in the industry before Dieno provided the event's final twist.

stories.title: Shota Umino Comments on Ryohei Oiwa and Callum Newman
stories.tldr: Shota Umino recently addressed the rapid rise of peers like Ryohei Oiwa and Callum Newman in New Japan Pro-Wrestling, making it clear that their swift success does not shake his confidence. Despite missing most of the G1 Climax due to a concussion and amnesia, Umino remains focused on his own developmental pace rather than rushing to copy others. He believes that his unique background and contrasting approach will ultimately help strengthen the promotion when he reaches the top to stay.

stories.title: AEW's Rush Denies 'Injury Prone' Claims and Confirms He is Healthy
stories.tldr: AEW star Rush has taken to social media to push back against online speculation and fan claims that he is injury prone following his prolonged absence from television. The former ROH World Champion clarified that he has only suffered one actual injury during his AEW tenure, alongside a minor knee tweak during the Continental Classic. Rush emphasized that he remains fully healthy, dedicated to his craft by training and studying in Mexico, and ready to return to action at any time.

stories.title: AEW Star John Silver Marries Partner Denise Liguori
stories.tldr: AEW star John Silver and his longtime partner, Denise Liguori, have officially tied the knot after getting engaged in June 2025. The couple celebrated their wedding on September 19, surrounded by family, friends, and familiar faces from the wrestling world, including fellow AEW star Chuck Taylor. Silver shared photos and videos from the ceremony on social media to announce the happy news to his fans.

stories.title: Sting's Son Garrett Borden Makes AEW In-Ring Debut
stories.tldr: Garrett Borden, the son of wrestling legend Sting and older brother of Steven Borden Jr., made his All Elite Wrestling in-ring debut in a dark match prior to the September 19 episode of Collision in Charleston, West Virginia. Training under Dustin Rhodes at the Rhodes Wrestling Association, Borden secured a victory over Kiran Grey. This milestone follows his professional debut earlier in May and his previous appearance portraying the Surfer Sting persona during his father's retirement match at Revolution 2024.

stories.title: Backstage Status Update on Britt Baker Following AEW Return
stories.tldr: Britt Baker recently made her long-awaited AEW return on the September 9 Rebel Heart edition of Dynamite after nearly two years away from the ring. Following her comeback match, where she teamed up with Hikaru Shida and Persephone to defeat Hyan, Maya World, and Thunder Rosa, reports indicate she is officially back on the road with the company. She is expected to make several upcoming television appearances as part of her return. Fans are especially anticipating her potential involvement in the September 30 episode of Dynamite, which takes place in her hometown of Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania, though an appearance for that specific date is not yet confirmed.

stories.title: Mercedes Moné's Ex-Husband Sarath Ton Expecting Baby Girl with New Wife
stories.tldr: Sarath Ton, known to wrestling fans as former WWE star and costume designer Mikaze, announced that he and his new wife Miranda are expecting a baby girl. Ton was previously married to wrestling star Mercedes Mone, though the couple actually separated quietly in December 2020 before their divorce became public in July 2024. Both have since moved on, with Ton marrying Miranda in late 2025 and Mone entering a relationship with AEW star The Beast Mortos.

stories.title: Tony Khan Thought The Outrunners Were Already Under AEW Contract
stories.tldr: The Outrunners recently shared the wild and persistent way they eventually secured their AEW contracts through relentless extra work and massive road trips. Truth Magnum and Turbo Floyd frequently lied about their locations to land bookings, tricking Tony Khan into assuming they were already officially signed to the roster. After ignoring a surreal Twitter direct message from Khan offering them a match against Sting, the duo officially cemented their unforgettable path into the company.

stories.title: Wrestling Observer Live Discusses Myron Reed's Potential in AEW
stories.tldr: A recent episode of Wrestling Observer Live hosted by Josh Nason explores Myron Reed's potential as a singles star in AEW following his standout match against Darby Allin on Collision. The discussion raises questions about whether Tony Khan will provide Reed with the necessary runway, while also contrasting his situation with the stalled momentum of Hook and Konosuke Takeshita. Additionally, the show touches upon the potential launch of Club WWE for the upcoming Worlds Collide event and fan reactions to paying for expanding content, alongside various notes on wrestling and the UFC.

stories.title: Malakai Black Pays Emotional Tribute to Late Musician Andy Williams
stories.tldr: Former WWE and AEW star Malakai Black recently paid an emotional tribute to his close friend and fellow wrestler Andy The Butcher Williams, who unexpectedly passed away on September 5 following a medical emergency during a tag team match. During an appearance on Zelvx and Charlie Girl, a visibly emotional Black recalled Williams as a genuinely wonderful human being and a loyal best friend who constantly shared his music and supported those around him. Black also shared the heartbreaking story of how he learned about the tragedy from Donovan Dijak backstage at a PROGRESS Wrestling event in England just hours before his own title match.

stories.title: Maria Kanellis Reveals AEW Extended Contract During Tumor Recovery
stories.tldr: Former wrestling star Maria Kanellis recently opened up about her harrowing health battle with a rare one-in-a-million tumor known as a pheochromocytoma. She revealed that AEW graciously extended her contract by three months while she was still recovering in the hospital following her surgery in October. The tumor severely impacted her physical and mental well-being by altering her hormones, affecting her heart, causing erratic blood pressure, and changing her personality. Despite the dark period and the difficult end to her active career, Kanellis remains deeply grateful for the support she received and the many blessings wrestling brought into her life.

stories.title: Rumors on AEW 2K Console Video Game Partnership Unlikely
stories.tldr: Industry reports indicate that a future partnership between video game publisher 2K and All Elite Wrestling is highly unlikely if the publisher's current deal with WWE eventually expires. Wrestling journalist Sean Ross Sapp addressed the rumor during a recent question and answer session, explaining that the two companies have fundamentally different philosophies regarding game development. While AEW prefers to support a single long-term title, 2K relies on an annual release model that would require substantial ongoing investment.

stories.title: AEW All Out 2026 Match Card Updates and Andrade Title Defense
stories.tldr: Following recent events on Collision, several major matches have been officially added to the upcoming All Out pay-per-view and its pre-show. Andrade El Idolo will officially defend his AEW National Championship against PAC after a post-match angle on Saturday night. Additionally, the Tailgate Brawl pre-show lineup has been fully fleshed out with new multi-man tag team action and a singles clash.

stories.title: Logan Paul and Jake Paul Tour Pentagon and Address Military Members
stories.tldr: WWE star Logan Paul and his brother Jake Paul recently toured the Pentagon and addressed U.S. military members, meeting with Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth. During the visit, both brothers delivered speeches expressing gratitude for the armed forces and the United States. This high-profile appearance aligns with a broader pattern of growing connections between prominent WWE figures and the current administration. Meanwhile, Logan Paul remains sidelined from in-ring action due to a triceps injury and is not expected to be cleared until at least November.

stories.title: Dustin Rhodes Reveals Details Behind Goldust vs Roddy Piper Backlot Brawl
stories.tldr: Dustin Rhodes recently shared fascinating behind-the-scenes details about the infamous Goldust versus Roddy Piper Backlot Brawl at WrestleMania XII. He revealed that the chaotic match only happened because original plans for a street fight against Razor Ramon fell apart just two weeks prior. Rhodes also discussed Vince McMahon's obsession with O.J. Simpson imagery for the segment and his own initial hesitation to fully embrace the androgynous nature of the Goldust character.

stories.title: WWE Lineup and Match Additions for September 21 Monday Night RAW
stories.tldr: WWE Raw General Manager Adam Pearce has announced a stacked lineup for the September 21, 2026 episode from the Frost Bank Center in San Antonio, Texas. The show features high stakes with men and women Money in the Bank qualifying matches, alongside intense personal rivalries like Bayley versus Lyra Valkyria. Additionally, both Penta and LA Knight are scheduled to address the WWE Universe following major developments surrounding World Heavyweight Champion Roman Reigns.

stories.title: Raquel Rodriguez Calls Judgment Day the Strongest Faction in WWE History
stories.tldr: Raquel Rodriguez recently spoke with the San Antonio Express-News about her time in The Judgment Day and the deep impact the faction has had on her career. She highlighted the stable's unbreakable family bond, noting that regardless of which members are traveling or appearing on television, the group always delivers full energy. Rodriguez even joked that kicking Finn Balor out of the group created a special trauma bonding experience for the remaining members. Ultimately, she boldly claimed that this loyalty and mindset make The Judgment Day the longest reigning and strongest faction in WWE history.

stories.title: Danhausen Reflects on WrestleMania Segment with John Cena and TV Cameo Hopes
stories.tldr: WWE star Danhausen recently reflected on sharing the ring with John Cena during a memorable segment at WrestleMania in Las Vegas, where he hit a Five-Knuckle Shuffle on The Miz before disappearing in a smoke bomb. Beyond the squared circle, Danhausen has been enjoying mainstream pop culture success following his viral involvement with the New York Knicks and ESPN appearances. Looking ahead, the very nice, very evil star has expressed ambitious career goals outside of wrestling, including a dream cameo on The Simpsons and pitching his own sitcom concept.

stories.title: John Cena WrestleMania 41 Trading Card Sells for Record $329,400
stories.tldr: A one-of-one John Cena trading card featuring his autograph and an event-used patch from WrestleMania 41 has sold at Goldin for a record-breaking $329,400. Bidding for the 2025 Topps Royalty card originally opened at $15,000 before escalating dramatically through fierce competition. The historic sale commemorates Cena defeating Cody Rhodes at the event to capture a record 17th WWE World Championship.

stories.title: Liv Morgan Names Favorite Crowd Reaction Involving Dominik Mysterio
stories.tldr: In a recent interview, Liv Morgan revealed that her all-time favorite WWE crowd reaction occurred at SummerSlam 2024 when Dominik Mysterio betrayed Rhea Ripley to help her retain the Women's World Championship. She highlighted the polarized crowd response to Mysterio's post-match kiss, noting that even Stephanie McMahon loved the iconic drama. Additionally, Morgan shared a surprising personal detail, disclosing that she is a legally ordained minister who can officiate weddings. This interview follows recent shifts in her career, including dropping her championship to Stephanie Vaquer.

stories.title: The Bryan & Vinny Show Podcast Episode Recap
stories.tldr: The latest episode of the podcast covers a busy week in professional wrestling, highlighted by the SmackDown recap featuring Sami Zayn versus Kevin Owens in a World Title match and ongoing build toward Money in the Bank. Hosts also review the AEW Collision card as the promotion builds momentum for the upcoming All Out pay-per-view event. Additionally, fans in the Philadelphia area are given details on where they can catch Bryan wrestling live and attending a book signing on Sunday.

stories.title: The Full Story and Legal Fallout of Janel Grant and Vince McMahon
stories.tldr: Former WWE employee Janel Grant filed a devastating federal lawsuit against Vince McMahon in 2024, accusing him of severe sexual abuse, trafficking, and coercion that began after they met in 2019. The explosive case quickly dragged other figures into the controversy while raising serious questions about corporate accountability within WWE. Although multiple legal battles, settlements, and a 2026 arbitration agreement ultimately pushed the public lawsuit out of the courts, Grant has continued to speak out about her experiences and the initial confidentiality agreements.

stories.title: WWE SmackDown Digital Exclusives and Match Notes
stories.tldr: Following Friday's episode of SmackDown, WWE released several digital exclusives highlighting new backstage feuds and challenges. Ricky Saints confronted AAA Cruiserweight Champion Rey Fenix, leading to a physical altercation after Saints demanded a title shot. Meanwhile, Blake Monroe demanded attention and vowed revenge against Giulia, while Baron Corbin sent a fierce warning to Trick Williams.

stories.title: Perry Saturn Reflects on Moppy Storyline as Vince McMahon Punishment
stories.tldr: Former WWE star Perry Saturn recently revealed that his infamous Moppy storyline was actually a punishment orchestrated by Vince McMahon. The creative direction stemmed from an incident during a match against Mike Bell where Saturn went off-script after being dropped on his head. Despite Saturn refusing to falsely promise Vince that he would never react defensively again, management assigned him the inanimate cleaning tool. Even though Saturn tried to prevent it from succeeding, the absurd gimmick surprisingly began to get over with fans before being abruptly ended.

stories.title: Speculation on Future Second and Third-Generation Factions in WWE
stories.tldr: The NXT faction BirthRight features strict guidelines requiring members to come from professional wrestling families. As the group prepares for a potential main roster transition, analysts are speculating on which second and third-generation stars could join. Names such as Dominik Mysterio, Bron Breakker, and Cody Rhodes offer intriguing possibilities ranging from new recruits to potential faction leaders. Each wrestler would bring unique family legacies and dynamic character storylines to the stable.

stories.title: Analyzing WWE Stars Who Could Benefit From a Brand Switch
stories.tldr: With the absence of a traditional WWE Draft, wrestlers who have hit creative walls on Monday Night Raw should consider a brand switch to revitalize their careers. Seth Rollins needs a move to SmackDown to escape stale storylines on Raw and pursue fresh feuds, including a potential program with Undisputed WWE Champion Sami Zayn. Similarly, IYO SKY has faded into the background on Raw following the returns of Stephanie Vaquer and Becky Lynch and would benefit from heading to SmackDown to chase the Interim WWE Women's Title while awaiting Rhea Ripley's return.

stories.title: Looking Ahead to Potential WWE Veteran Retirements in 2027
stories.tldr: Following a wave of high profile retirements over a recent thirteen month span, attention is turning toward which wrestling veterans might hang up their boots in 2027. The Bella Twins are among those projected to finish up, with Nikki Bella having previously revealed plans to retire from in-ring competition by the end of 2027 following their recent return. Hall of Famer Rey Mysterio continues to take brutal punishments and put on classic matches at age 51, leading to speculation about a potential final match against his son Dominik. Meanwhile, Asuka has stepped away temporarily due to a personal matter but could potentially return in 2027 for a final run and a proper sendoff.

stories.title: Jim Cornette Discusses Origin of Tennis Racket and Early John Cena
stories.tldr: Wrestling legend Jim Cornette recently sat down for a WWE Photo Shoot segment to look back at his storied career through a collection of archival pictures. During the interview, he shared the fascinating backstory behind his iconic tennis racket and offered rare insights into the very early days of John Cena's wrestling journey. The discussion provided fans with a nostalgic and informative look at different eras of professional wrestling through the eyes of one of its most outspoken managers.

stories.title: WWE Vault Releases Full Episode of Legends with JBL Featuring Hall & Nash
stories.tldr: The WWE Vault YouTube channel has released a full episode of Legends with JBL featuring professional wrestling icons Scott Hall and Kevin Nash. The in-depth conversation covers major historical topics in the industry, including the formation and impact of the nWo and the controversial influence of The Kliq. Fans can now stream the complete interview to hear firsthand stories from two of the most influential figures in Monday Night War history.

stories.title: Original Creative Plans Behind JBL's Unexpected Clothesline Spree Revealed
stories.tldr: For months, former WWE Champion JBL surprised fans across various independent promotions by randomly appearing to deliver his signature Clothesline From Hell without any immediate explanation. Recent reports have revealed that Major League Wrestling and other independent promoters tried to build long-term storylines around these attacks, including a potential Battle of the Lariats against Satoshi Kojima or a Yellowstone-inspired bitter cowboy invasion angle. However, these creative plans ultimately fell through because JBL only wanted to hit his signature move and create a buzz without committing to a full program or taking a loss. Ultimately, the viral spree was simply a fun way for JBL to help smaller promotions gain attention and scratch his own wrestling itch on his own terms.

stories.title: WWE Vault Highlights Top Matches from 2001 WCW/ECW Invasion
stories.tldr: The WWE Vault is revisiting one of the most chaotic and memorable eras in professional wrestling history by highlighting top matches from the 2001 Invasion storyline. During this period, the combined forces of World Championship Wrestling and Extreme Championship Wrestling attempted a hostile takeover of the World Wrestling Federation. Fans can now relive these classic televised bouts that defined a major cross-promotional war.

stories.title: Mick Foley Calls Out Donald Trump Over White House Media Ban
stories.tldr: WWE Hall of Famer Mick Foley recently used his Instagram Story to criticize President Donald Trump after reporters from CNN, MSNBC and Politico had their White House credentials confiscated and were denied entry. Foley condemned the action as a terrifying blow to democracy, continuing his months-long trend of openly questioning Trump's leadership and political empathy. While Trump defended the ban by citing years of what he calls fake news, critics argue the decision severely threatens press freedom.

stories.title: Prospective WWE Talent Recalls Security Escort After Triple H Encounter
stories.tldr: Former OVW Heavyweight Champion Jamin Olivencia recently recalled how a series of backstage missteps in 2014 and 2015 ruined his chances of signing with WWE. After being encouraged by Stephanie McMahon to speak with Triple H about securing a meeting, Olivencia repeatedly approached Triple H at inopportune times to pitch himself. This persistence ultimately led to him being escorted out of the building by security and fueled a bizarre backstage rumor that he had followed Triple H into a bathroom.

stories.title: Potential Seth Rollins Rivalries Upon His Return to WWE Television
stories.tldr: Seth Rollins has been absent from WWE television since SummerSlam 2026 but recently made his in-ring return during a South American live tour, signaling an imminent return to weekly programming. As he prepares to come back, there are three major stars he could reignite past rivalries with, including LA Knight, Bron Breakker, and Drew McIntyre. These potential feuds offer fresh dynamic shifts and high-stakes rematches for the former World Heavyweight Champion upon his comeback.

stories.title: Rob Conway Recalls Receiving High Praise From Vince McMahon
stories.tldr: Former WWE star Rob Conway recently reflected on his time with the company and shared a memorable piece of high praise he received from Vince McMahon during his run as part of La Résistance. According to Conway, McMahon compared his in-ring work favorably to WWE legend Bret Hart while encouraging him to focus more on his character and gimmick. Conway explained how this feedback shaped his approach to wrestling, leading to a greater emphasis on generating heat rather than purely focusing on five-star matches.

stories.title: Predicting Roman Reigns' Next WWE Title Opponents and Rematches
stories.tldr: With Roman Reigns holding the WWE World Heavyweight Championship, the Original Tribal Chief faces a massive target on his back and is lined up for several high profile rematches. Confirmed and rumored contenders include LA Knight, his former family member Solo Sikoa, WrestleMania opponent CM Punk, and his ultimate rival Cody Rhodes. These potential bouts build on deep storytelling, past title encounters, and historic matches that continue to shape the current landscape of WWE.

stories.title: NXT Call-Ups Aligning with Main Roster WWE Factions
stories.tldr: Recent WWE main roster call-ups have increasingly seen former NXT talent align with established stars on Raw and SmackDown, creating fresh faction dynamics. Rumors suggest even more crossovers are on the horizon as NXT prospects are positioned to join forces with main roster veterans. Potential future alliances range from returning international connections and independent wrestling tag-team reunions to dominant family bloodline stables. These strategic pairings aim to shake up the brand landscapes and provide compelling new storylines for fans.

stories.title: Seth Rollins Reacts to Chicago Bears Loss and Caleb Williams Injury
stories.tldr: WWE star and avid Chicago Bears fan Seth Rollins experienced a massive swing in emotions during the opening weeks of the NFL season. After celebrating a dominant week one performance, his mood soured entirely when the Bears managed only three points in a brutal week two loss to the Minnesota Vikings. To make matters worse, rookie quarterback Caleb Williams suffered a fourth-quarter leg injury and had to be carted off the field, prompting Rollins to angrily declare on social media that he hates football for life.

stories.title: Speculation and Creative Plans for Trish Stratus' Return to WWE
stories.tldr: Following recent comments from WWE Hall of Famer Trish Stratus about the right conditions for an in-ring comeback, speculation has grown regarding her potential return to the company. Stratus last wrestled in July 2025, and her future appearances depend on checking specific boxes to pay the business forward. Industry discussions have now highlighted three potential creative directions for her next steps, including teaming up with rising talent Sol Ruca or facing stars like Rhea Ripley and Blake Monroe.

stories.title: Status and Return Timelines for Injured WWE Stars
stories.tldr: Following recent high-profile returns on WWE programming, attention has turned to other talent currently sidelined with various injuries. This report breaks down the current status and expected recovery timelines for Logan Paul, Elio LeFleur, Brie Bella, and Rhea Ripley. While Paul and LeFleur are nearing the final stages of their respective rehabilitations from arm and shoulder surgeries, Brie Bella and Rhea Ripley face more fluid timelines regarding their eventual in-ring comebacks.

stories.title: Jim Ross Admits He Was Embarrassed to Be Booked in WWE TV Angles
stories.tldr: Legendary wrestling commentator Jim Ross recently admitted that he felt embarrassed being booked into physical storylines and matches during his tenure with WWE. Despite participating in notable bouts like a main event at Madison Square Garden against Triple H, Ross felt ill-equipped and untrained for these physical roles. He ultimately left WWE in 2019 and transitioned to AEW, where he signed a massive commentary contract.

stories.title: Highlighting Stephanie Vaquer's Women's World Championship Run in WWE
stories.tldr: Stephanie Vaquer has enjoyed an explosive start to her WWE career, transitioning from a surprise signing after appearances in CMLL, NJPW, and AEW to capturing multiple championships. After dominant runs in NXT that included holding gold as a double champion, she recently defeated Liv Morgan in Santiago, Chile, to capture the WWE Women's World Championship with help from Becky Lynch. Now leading the Raw women's division, Vaquer has returned triumphantly to Mexico City and is already embroiled in high-stakes feuds involving The Judgment Day and Rey Mysterio.

stories.title: Bronson Reed Reflects on Turning on Seth Rollins as Career Highlight
stories.tldr: Bronson Reed recently reflected on his shocking betrayal of Seth Rollins in Australia as a major highlight of his WWE career. Alongside Bron Breakker and Paul Heyman, Reed attacked Rollins last October following Crown Jewel, effectively ending their alliance in The Vision. Reed noted that the surprise attack in front of his home country crowd made the moment unforgettable. Because both men subsequently suffered injuries, they never got to square off in the ring, leaving Reed eager for a future clash.

stories.title: Blake Monroe Pitches 'Legend Killer' Gimmick in WWE
